name: tinycad-manual
description: Local build scripts for TinyCAD manual GitHub Pages site

scripts.build: npm run bundle:install && npm run clean && npm run prepare:translations && npm run build:search-index && bundle exec jekyll build --source docs --destination _site
scripts.serve: npm run bundle:install && npm run clean && npm run prepare:translations && npm run build:search-index && bundle exec jekyll serve --source docs --destination _site --livereload --open-url
